svg.text: Seeker calls GET search-jobs with optional filters (location, role, org); token identifies the user; results paginated

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gateway authenticates (token / client id), throttles abusive callers, spreads load

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If filters are missing, the service loads the user's profile (cached; changes rarely)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Query Elasticsearch on the searchable tags to get candidate job ids (~10M active jobs)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Candidate ids go to the ranking service

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ranking asks the personalization model for a relevance score per job (applying to a company is a strong signal, a view a weak one)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If personalization fails, ranking degrades to simple rules (newest first) instead of failing the request

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Service fetches full job details by id from the NoSQL jobs store and returns the ranked page

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Employer posts, edits or closes a job

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Job manager persists the complete record

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Active jobs are synced to the search index; expired or deleted jobs are removed (low write rate vs. very high read rate)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 100M DAU, ~40% (40M) search jobs, ~4 searches each; 10M active jobs; target <200 ms backend, <1 s perceived

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Eventual consistency is fine: a brand-new posting appearing in the next result set is acceptable

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Availability: replicas, multi-AZ, region-local data stores for GDPR; degrade ranking rather than fail
